question: How did investment properties compare with primary residences on default rate in 2016?

args.query: SELECT bucket, vintage, loans, defaults, default_rate, mean_predicted, declined_share FROM segments WHERE dimension = 'occupancy_status' AND vintage = 2016 AND bucket IN ('P', 'I')

content.text:
In 2016, investment properties (occupancy status 'I') had 3,955 loans, 16 defaults, and a default rate of 0.40% (mean predicted default probability 0.63%, declined share 1.19%).

Primary residences (occupancy status 'P') had 44,052 loans, 387 defaults, and a default rate of 0.88% (mean predicted default probability 0.67%, declined share 1.11%).
